name: How do I choose the right contractor for a garage addition?
description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with a strong portfolio and local permitting experience. Obtain multiple bids and check references.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your garage addition, look for licensed and insured professionals with a strong portfolio of similar projects and positive client testimonials. It's important to choose a company with experience navigating the specific permitting processes in your city, like Hayward or San Leandro. We recommend obtaining multiple detailed bids and verifying references to ensure quality and reliability.
